answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by anchoring network actors to dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and slashing penalties that attain the summit of capital efficiency. By calibrating staking collateral through subgame-perfect punishment matrices, the expected payoff for node multiplication is rendered negative, ensuring the protocol remains a secure haven.
